body.name: Gamma_K
body.def: For every \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm{anc}}\) and \((s,x,u,w)\) with \(w\in J_x\), \(\Gamma_{s,x,u,w,a}:D_a\to\{\xi:\operatorname{supp}(\xi)\subseteq\mathcal Y^+_{s,x,u,w},\ \sum_y\xi(y)=0\}\) is a fixed linear map satisfying \(\mathscr L_{s,x,u,w}\Gamma_{s,x,u,w,a}d=d\).
